name: Gridfinity Baseplates
frame: Plate in the XY plane, z = 0 is its underside; front = -Y, left = -X. Every piece is modelled centred on its own origin.

official._source: gridfinity.xyz/specification, as encoded in gridfinity-rebuilt-openscad src/core/gridfinity-baseplate.scad (_BASEPLATE_PROFILE, BASEPLATE_HEIGHT, BASEPLATE_OUTER_RADIUS) and standard.scad (magnets)

pocket._note: [z above the pocket floor, offset inward from the 42 mm cell outline], bottom up: 0.35 clearance, 0.7 @ 45 deg, 1.8 vertical, 2.15 @ 45 deg up to the knife edge on the cell outline. Corner radius = 4 - offset (1.15 at the opening). A box's foot rests on the floor and on both 45 deg faces.

magnet._note: 4 per cell at (+-13, +-13) from the cell centre, under the box magnets, cut into the bottom plate from its top face

design._min_strip: border strips narrower than this are dropped (the plate gets that much smaller); avoids sliver faces
design._box_top: a box of n units is 7 n + 3.55 tall with its stacking lip (bin_params.json); it stands on the pocket floor
